tutorials.title: Quick: An Introduction to Skia with Pictures
tutorials.goal: Draw a moonlit lake from shapes, paints, and a shared drawing function.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required. The example writes PNG, PDF, and SVG files.

tutorials.title: Transforms and Coordinate Systems — Build a Clock
tutorials.goal: Place repeated geometry by translating, rotating, and scaling the canvas.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: Paths and Geometry — Draw a Logo
tutorials.goal: Construct contours from lines and curves, then fill and stroke them.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: Images — Build a Contact Sheet
tutorials.goal: Decode, crop, sample, and fit images into a contact sheet.
requirements: The four image fixtures are copied with the program. No image download is needed.

tutorials.title: Paints, Gradients, and Shaders — Make a Poster
tutorials.goal: Combine paints, gradients, transparency, and image shaders.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: Text and Typography — Make a Type Specimen
tutorials.goal: Position simple text using baselines, advances, ink bounds, and font metrics.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: Shaping and Multilingual Text — Make a Language Sampler
tutorials.goal: Select script fonts and shape individual runs into positioned glyphs.
requirements: HarfBuzz and fonts covering the complete Arabic and Hebrew samples are required. A
missing script font produces an error with installation guidance.

tutorials.title: Paragraph Layout — Make a Multilingual Article Card
tutorials.goal: Wrap and align text, then resolve font and direction changes in paragraphs.
requirements: HarfBuzz and fonts covering the mixed Arabic, Hebrew, and Latin text are required.

tutorials.title: PDF and SVG — Make a Printable Diagram
tutorials.goal: Give a drawing physical dimensions and export PDF, SVG, and a PNG preview.
requirements: HarfBuzz is needed for the caption. Only the single-font wrapping sections of Paragraph
Layout are prerequisites; the mixed-script sections are optional.

tutorials.title: Effects and Filters — Make a Card with Shadows
tutorials.goal: Compare shadows, mask blur, and image blur while keeping geometry unchanged.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: Reusable Drawings — Record and Replay a Picture
tutorials.goal: Record a drawing and replay it with different positions, sizes, and angles.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: Vector Output and Raster Fallbacks — What Stays Vector?
tutorials.goal: Distinguish vector operations, source pixels, and bounded raster fallbacks.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: GPU Rendering — Render the Same Scene on the GPU
tutorials.goal: Use one drawing function with CPU and platform-specific GPU backends.
requirements: The default command uses the CPU. Metal requires macOS; Direct3D requires Windows x64.
The Linux OpenGL example needs a graphical session with a usable GLX context.

tutorials.title: Animation — Orbiting Lights in a Window
tutorials.goal: Animate elapsed time, schedule frames, and manage a CPU or GPU window.
requirements: Both renderers need a graphical session. GPU mode also needs a supported native backend.

tutorials.title: Interactive Paths — Drag Bézier Control Points
tutorials.goal: Edit a curve with mouse input, hit testing, and redraw requests.
requirements: Both renderers need a graphical session. GPU mode also needs a supported native backend.

tutorials.title: Zoom and Pan — Navigate an Interactive Canvas
tutorials.goal: Pan and zoom a view while mapping pointer positions back into model space.
requirements: Both renderers need a graphical session. GPU mode also needs a supported native backend.

tutorials.title: Runtime Shaders — Animate Prismatic Waves in a Window
tutorials.goal: Animate a compiled SkSL effect by changing uniforms, not the drawing API.
requirements: The window needs a graphical session. Running waves.rkt alone saves a CPU still image.

tutorials.title: Working with Pixels — Build a Two-Ink Image Processor
tutorials.goal: Edit CPU pixels while distinguishing buffers, borrowed views, and snapshots.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: Color Spaces — Give Pixel Values Their Meaning
tutorials.goal: Give samples a color-space interpretation and save matching profile metadata.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: Path Operations — Construct a Cutout Badge
tutorials.goal: Combine filled regions to construct a badge with genuine holes.
requirements: Skia and its native library are required; no GPU is needed.

tutorials.title: Sprite Atlases — Animate Bouncing Balls on the GPU
tutorials.goal: Retain one atlas across GPU frames and change only its sprite placements.
requirements: The window needs a graphical session. The atlas is generated locally. The snapshot
command uses the CPU without opening a window.

tutorials.title: Star Squadron — Build a Galaga-Inspired Arcade Game
tutorials.goal: Combine a fixed-step game simulation with animated atlas sprites.
requirements: The window needs a graphical session. Artwork and shared support files are included. The
snapshot command uses the CPU without opening a window.
